TC-06/S07.title: Badge -> pre-selected template, override holds, picker matches what Generate uses (Hospital)
TC-06/S07.detail: Local 25acd727, mocked copies of Tim's three titles (the third, 'Generate writes the note in the format the status pre-selected', stores a note and would queue the server billing job, so it is not run as lane A). Copy 1: soap -> hp (New Admission) -> Discharge picked by hand held across a tab change -> consult -> soap (1/1). Copy 2: a picked custom template that is deleted leaves the picker on SOAP progress (1/1). Copy 3, four Generate legs (Consult pre-selected; New Admission overridden to SOAP progress; New Admission H&P; Discharge summary by hand), generateNote answered at the socket and the note save refused there: in each leg the picker value, the template instructions sent in patientContext and the noteTemplate the app tries to save all match (consult / soap / hp / discharge), and nothing was stored (8/8). The stored noteTemplate after a real Generate is checked on dev (TC-18/S05 n-legs, dev results).
